title: PlayerTradingUltimate
description: A simple trading system in Minecraft
body:
PlayerTradingUltimate is a plugin that allows for safe, easy trading between players. This plugin is intended to prevent "scams" between players, where one player doesn't get what they were promised.

To start a trade, simply run /trade <player>. The other player will be sent a request to trade. To reload the plugin configuration, ensure you have the permission ptu.admin (or operator), and run /ptu reload

This plugin requires [Vault](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/vault) and a compatible economy plugin (e.g. [EssentialsX](https://modrinth.com/plugin/essentialsx)) to work. Please install these on your server alongside this plugin.
